description: List posted Grants.gov opportunities whose application deadline falls within the next 1 to 120 days (default 30), soonest first, with days left counted in Eastern Time. Takes the same keyword, applicant type, category, instrument, agency and Assistance Listing filters as search_grants. Listings with no close date or a placeholder close date are left out.

agency.description: An agency code (USDA, HHS-NIH11, DOI-FWS) or name ("Fish and Wildlife", "Rural Business"). A department code includes all of its sub-agencies.

assistance_listing.description: Assistance Listing (formerly CFDA) number, for example 10.868.

categories.description: Grants.gov category codes: AG Agriculture, AR Arts, BC Business and Commerce, CD Community Development, CP Consumer Protection, DPR Disaster Prevention and Relief, ED Education, ELT Employment, Labor and Training, EN Energy, ENV Environment, FN Food and Nutrition, HL Health, HO Housing, HU Humanities, IIJ Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, IS Information and Statistics, ISS Income Security and Social Services, LJL Law, Justice and Legal Services, NR Natural Resources, O Other, OZ Opportunity Zone Benefits, RD Regional Development, RT Recreation and Tourism, ST Science and Technology, T Transportation.

eligibility.description: Applicant types to match, such as small_business, nonprofit_501c3, nonprofit_other, tribal_government, city_or_township_government, individual. A listing matches when it is open to any of them.

include_unrestricted.description: When eligibility is set, also include Unrestricted (code 99) listings, which are open to any applicant type. Default true.

keyword.description: Words to search for in listing titles and text, for example "rural energy" or "STEM education".

name: grants_closing_soon
title: Grants closing soon
